elevate.move: Make the knife pass the visible verb of the scroll: the blade sweeps once along each band's seam as it enters, leaving the edge finer than the last (rough teeth at services, a hairline at the form), and skims the ledger rows one by one, so a mid-scroll frame catches it mid-pass

Collapse the story's empty pin run into a tight panel-led band, and set the sizer and ledger as one 'wall sheet': the drawn patch grows into a full-height board with the price rows ruled across it, so the dense middle reads as one material object instead of two cards with a hole between them
